unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Don't forget to save your updates.

filterWizard.heading: Course Filter Wizard (Learner Catalogue)
filterWizard.description: The first time a learner opens the course catalogue, ask them to pick filters step by step, then show only the matching courses.
filterWizard.order: Learners are asked in this fixed order — {{level}}, then {{session}}, then {{tag}} — skipping any step left unchecked.

viewSettings.heading: Course View & Display Settings
viewSettings.copiedSlideDescription: When a slide is copied to another course, choose whether the copy stays a draft, matches the original's published state, or is always published. Draft copies are not visible to learners.
viewSettings.showContentDescriptionsHint: Display the description entered for a module or chapter under its title on the content cards — in Course Details and in the learner app. Turn off to keep those cards title-only.

permissions.heading: User Permissions & Access Control
permissions.filterHint: Controls whether Explore Courses shows only parent batches, only child batches, or all batches by default.

enrollmentNotifications.heading: Enrollment Notifications
enrollmentNotifications.description: Controls which notification toggles admins see in the bulk enrollment dialog. When a toggle is turned off here, the corresponding option is hidden in the dialog AND forced to off in the API request — so no emails go out by accident.

footerNote.label: Note:
footerNote.text: Changes will be applied across your entire institute once saved. All course creation flows will use these updated settings.
